Introduction: Psst. I’m Natalica. Codename: Shadow Cub.$h#$b#Don’t tell Carrie I introduced myself with the codename.
Mon: Official mission: reconnaissance. Unofficial mission: finding the best snacks in town.$h
Tue: Carrie made a schedule for our trip to the store.$b#A schedule. For buying seeds. Can you believe it?
Wed: Those sunglasses? They’re for looking mysterious. Also, they’re really comfortable.$h
Thu: I bet I could find every hidden path around here before Carrie finishes her morning checklist.
Fri: You didn’t see me. I wasn’t here. And if Carrie asks, I definitely wasn’t borrowing any gadgets.$h
Sat: The best part of a small town? Everyone thinks nothing interesting ever happens.
Sun: I like hanging out with my sister. Just don’t tell her I said that.$h
rainy_day: Rain is great cover for a secret mission.$h#$b#Or for staying inside with snacks. Both work.
fall_1: Fallen leaves are surprisingly loud. Terrible for stealth.
winter_1: Snow tracks give away your position. Good thing I’m not on a mission today.$h
